```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis
csv_name <- "chartbook_F6.csv"
csv_tmp  <- file.path(tempdir(), csv_name)
download.file(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GPID-WB/pip-chartbook/refs/heads/main/csv/chartbook_F6.csv",
  destfile = csv_tmp,
  mode = "wb",
  quiet = TRUE
)
# Plain <a download> holding the CSV as a data: URI.
# downloadthis::download_file() is deliberately NOT used here: the handler it
# generates calls fetch() on the data: URI, and PositConnect serves a
# Content-Security-Policy whose connect-src has no data:, so the fetch was
# blocked and the button failed with "Download failed. Please try again."
# An anchor download is not governed by any CSP directive.
cat(sprintf(
  '<div class="cell-output-display"><a class="btn btn-primary" href="data:text/csv;base64,%s" download="%s"><i class="bi bi-download"></i> Download data as csv</a></div>',
  xfun::base64_encode(csv_tmp), csv_name
))
```

<p style="font-size: 0.5em; color: #555; margin-top: 0.5em;">

Note: Poverty rates are shown relative to 2019 levels for the \$3.00 and \$8.30 per person per day poverty lines (expressed in 2021 PPP dollars). Population coverage is less than 50 percent of the group's population for low-income countries in 2019 and 2024, and for lower-middle-income countries in 2019. The estimates after 2024 are nowcasts. High-income countries are omitted because poverty rates are small. Income group is kept fixed using the fiscal year 2027 classifications.

</p>
